title: Duolingo Avatar Editor
description: Create, edit, and export Duolingo-style avatars, or turn a prompt into an editable design.
descriptionZh: 创建、编辑并导出 Duolingo 风格的头像，也可以用文字生成可继续调整的头像配置。

title: Ball Growth Lab
description: Adjust gravity, boundary gaps, and reproduction rates to explore how a bouncing ball population changes.
descriptionZh: 调整重力、边界缺口和繁殖概率，观察球群碰撞后的变化。

title: Python Interpreter Lab
description: Inspect real CPython compilation or debug a bounded teaching VM with breakpoints and source stepping.
descriptionZh: 在浏览器中观察真实 CPython 编译结果，并逐步运行有界教学 VM 子集。

title: Guns’n’Glory Learning Edition
description: Explore Cow Gulch and select a gunslinger in the first playable browser slice.
descriptionZh: 在首个可玩网页切片中探索牛溪谷地图并选择枪手。

title: Usagi animated pet
description: Preview Usagi in motion and follow setup steps for desktop, web, and Codex CLI.
descriptionZh: 预览 Usagi 动画，并查看桌面端、网页端和 Codex CLI 的安装与选择步骤。

title: 3D Objects
description: Browse a collection of interactive 3D object modules.
descriptionZh: 浏览由独立对象模块组成的交互式 3D 物体集合。
